audit.framing_9x16: Vertical stacked split-screen layout with a reaction facecam at the bottom and a browser/video playback window at the top, bordered by solid black letterboxing and a top caption banner.
audit.subtitle_craft: Minimalist or absent subtitles, relying almost entirely on the raw audio track of the streamer speaking and laughing.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Static framing with no active digital zooms or pan-and-scan camera work, relying on the inherent visual content of the browser window and facecam.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Minimal SFX usage, depending heavily on the organic comedy of the streamer's interaction with a door stopper sound video and natural laughter.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Straightforward linear clip progression from setup (explaining the door stopper) to payoff (demonstrating it on stream), letting the comedic reaction play out fully without abrupt cuts.
standout_techniques: Stacked vertical layout keeping both reaction facecam and source video visible simultaneously
Clean title hook banner at the very top ('BRO TRIED TO PROVE HE DIDNT FART 😂')
Allowing natural comedic pauses and laughing fits to breathe without over-editing
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Lack of dynamic subtitles for viewer accessibility
Static unmoving frame layout without punch-ins or visual emphasis during key comedic moments
Excessive empty black space in the 9:16 canvas
